description: MANDATE-15 / TF1-98: su co that tren EKS (ecommerce-dev-eks / techx-tf1). Dua cart ve 0 replica. Chon cart vi do tren cum cho thay checkout goi CartService/GetCart tren DUNG 100% so lan PlaceOrder (489 tren 489 trong 2h truoc do bom), tuc day la phu thuoc DONG BO that su nam tren duong di cua don hang. Khi cart chet, PlaceOrder that bai va checkout tu ghi rpc_grpc_status_code=13 tren metric server-side cua chinh no -> grpc-error-rate-high phai keu.
notes: Ca nay THAY THE case_payment_outage_eks.json lam ca 'bat duoc' cua bo do tren EKS. Ca payment van giu trong bo vi no ghi lai mot diem mu that (xem result.json cua no + report/mandate15-eks/report.md muc 4): payment da chuyen sang tieu thu Kafka (topic domain.checkout.orders) nen giet no KHONG sinh loi o dau ca.
off scale ve 2 = dung minReplicas cua HPA cart (min 2, max 6), nen HPA tiep quan binh thuong sau khi khoi phuc.
Ti le loi mong doi ~0.109 chu khong gan 1.0: mau so cua rule gom ca RPC health-check Check (0.582 req/s) lan PlaceOrder (0.071 req/s).
